measurement: INFERENZA design: fast evoked EPSC (or fEPSP slope) and mEPSC at -70 mV in the burst-recording medium (Mg2+, K+, 35 C, P13-P17, layer II/III) before and during the AMPA tool, as a time course until the block is stable, reported as the achieved percent block (variable, not a nominal concentration).
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The slice papers read verify block in other cells, at -90 mV and in a different aCSF (Digby) or not at all (Dominguez-Sala latency); no paper gives a time to steady state or a washout in the Wwox preparation.

measurement: NMDAR EPSC (depolarised potential, or a separate set of cells) at the working concentration of the AMPA tool, against vehicle.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Perampanel NMDA neutrality is a culture result (30 uM, n = 6); GYKI 53655 NMDA and GABA-A inactivity rests on a paper not reached; the NBQX statement is an abstract; none is a measurement in this tissue. UPDATE: NBQX glycine-site action remains abstract-level after the open-route search (Q16-Q20).

measurement: Resting potential, input resistance and spike width before and during the tool.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: A tool that moves them imitates a general cut of drive; the Wwox network already differs in resting potential and input resistance (earlier package), so only a paired measurement in this preparation answers it. Partial transfer datum: Down-state potential with 10 uM GYKI-53655 -62.7 vs -63.5 mV in entorhinal layer III (n = 5; Digby Results 3.6); no input resistance or spike width, a different region and age bracket, so it does not replace the Wwox measurement.

measurement: Block fraction of the fast EPSC at low and at high stimulation or repetition (single pulse versus a train that raises glutamate and desensitisation), for the competitive and the noncompetitive tool.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The gating-state dependence of the block (Yamada abstract) and the surmountability of a competitive tool in a burst cannot be read from single-pulse culture or recombinant data.

measurement: Kainate-receptor contribution: the slow non-NMDA EPSC component remaining after the AMPA tool at the working concentration, and its sensitivity to a kainate antagonist used in Digby (UBP-302 is named there; no mechanism paper for it was read here).
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The windows read are recombinant (GluK2 homomer 58 uM versus GluA2 0.89 uM) or abstracts (GluK5 heteromers); whether layer II/III neocortical synapses carry GluK5-containing receptors is unmeasured. UPDATE: the NBQX window is now a recombinant binding Ki (Chalupnik 2022, 4 C, sf9 membranes), not a current in tissue. Partial transfer datum: in barrel cortex layers III and V no slow non-NMDA EPSC component was detectable at -90 mV and 20 uM UBP-302 did not change spontaneous Up-state duration (n = 5 per layer; Digby Results 3.3 and 3.5); different region and age bracket, so it does not replace the Wwox measurement.

measurement: Occlusion test: perampanel applied after saturating GYKI 53655 (and the reverse) on the evoked EPSC; no added block means one site, added block by NBQX means an independent site.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The Hanada displacement paper was not reached; the structures (Yelshanskaya) are recombinant GluA2 at 1 mM; no functional occlusion in neurons or slices was read.

measurement: Order and washout: time for the AMPA tool to wash out of the slice on the fast EPSC, with d-APV washed first (BE4 order).
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Tissue washout is not in the papers read (Digby: no washout statement found; Dominguez-Sala: latency recovery only); culture offset is seconds.
